concepts.name: 光环
concepts.detail: Visual direction 1 — PHOTON HALO. The AI is a SINGLE refined optical hoop floating in empty space, nearly circular but viewed with a very slight diagonal tilt, an impossibly thin polished glass and titanium loop with an empty black interior. The rim has razor-fine white-blue highlights that gently taper into darkness; one short arc has the faintest indigo-violet dispersion. This is an optical sculpture, not a HUD circle or sound ripple. Minimal monolithic appearance, smooth continuous material. Extremely restrained cold blue and pearl, zero atmospheric smoke. The ring itself is the entire assistant presence. Cards have only pearl edge highlights.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity raster concept for the Norma voice assistant desktop app.
Create ONE polished landscape 16:10 desktop interface screenshot, straight-on pixel-perfect flat UI, not a device render, not a mood board, not a montage. This is a complete usable app concept rather than a poster. The user wants an exceptionally minimal, sophisticated science-fiction assistant with Apple's clarity and luxurious optical glass. Deep true-black background covers at least 70% of the frame. Enormous calm negative space. Restrained pearl-white system sans-serif typography, legible Chinese, generous spacing, meticulously aligned controls.
Interface: top-left small lowercase wordmark "norma"; top-right only two small glass circular buttons with a history and settings icon. Place the AI form near the middle, a compact beautiful focal object around 230px across in a 1536px-wide screen, not a gigantic hero illustration. Below the AI small status "我在听", then a short sentence "告诉我，你想做什么". At bottom center a narrow dark translucent rounded voice input bar labelled "与 Norma 对话…" with a microphone button, subtle real optical edge catches, not a glowing chunky pill.
Just above the input, show two understated compact smoked-glass content cards, aligned horizontally, plenty of space around them: one labelled "项目进度" with "72%" and a very fine progress indicator; another labelled "文件" with "Design.pdf". These are secondary surfaces, with readable text, delicate reflected upper edges, realistic glass thickness and barely visible shadows. Do not surround the whole app with a large rounded border.
Constraints: make futuristic sophistication through precise optics and an arresting AI form, keep the rest almost invisible. No dense HUD, no dashboard, no grids, no decorative code, no tiny unreadable labels, no nebula, no starfield, no concentric ripples, no lens flare, no huge rainbow glow, no pyramids, no full-screen gradient, no fantasy environment, no mockup outside the screen, no watermark. Do not put the concept name or number inside the UI.

concepts.name: 液态玻璃
concepts.detail: Visual direction 2 — LIQUID LENS. The AI is a levitating transparent liquid-glass rounded pebble, spherical overall but gently asymmetrical and lenslike, with a convincing thick clear optical shell, subtle internal refraction, two beautiful large studio-light reflections and a narrow pale mint chromatic caustic at the lower edge. The center is dark transparent, not a cloudy glowing texture. Fine silver rim, subtle soft physical deformation frozen mid-listening, ultra tactile glass, a small restrained warm amber glint on one edge. It must look like a real impossible optical object, premium industrial-design photography integrated into the interface. Cards and input use colorless smoked crystal.

concepts.name: 全息光核
concepts.detail: Visual direction 3 — HOLOGRAPHIC CORE. Replace every ring and orb with a compact levitating rounded superellipsoid made from a tiny number of nearly invisible transparent holographic planes. At its core a precise luminous vertical cyan-white filament, with a small contained electric blue glow and pale lavender refracted facets, creates a sculptural light core. The shape is softly squared with rounded corners, luminous volume but absolutely no smoke, no stars, no particles sprayed outside. It feels like advanced future holographic computation, translucent and weightless, engineered rather than organic, elegant cinematic science fiction. Thin cyan optical highlights on the two card edges and voice control. This is distinct from a glass ball.

concepts.name: 悬浮薄片
concepts.detail: Visual direction 4 — FLOATING LAMINA. The AI is a spatial sculpture of THREE wafer-thin translucent opal-glass blades, gently bowed, floating in a precise balanced arrangement resembling three minimal petals or an abstract iris, not a flower illustration. There is clearly black empty space between the individual blades. Each blade catches pearl, icy lavender and the faintest rose dispersion; crisp edges, very smooth finite solid surfaces. The form spans horizontally and has an identifiable three-part silhouette rather than a sphere. It suggests the surfaces can flex with speech, exquisite engineered glass, no silk fabric, no ribbons wound into a ball, no holographic wireframe. Keep all UI surfaces neutral smoke-gray with subtle opalescent edges.

concepts.name: 单色声场
concepts.detail: Visual direction 5 — MONOCHROME VOICE. Entire app is strictly black, silver and pearl-white, absolutely no blue, purple or other color. The AI is a compact levitating three-dimensional voice sculpture made of 17 slender polished white-silver vertical rods with round ends, arranged along a shallow elliptical depth curve, smoothly graduated lengths forming an abstract soft ovoid silhouette. A few rods are slightly taller mid-speech, visually implying pitch and energy. The rods are sculpted solid optical light, beautifully graduated specular reflections and depth, not a flat audio equalizer, not a waveform chart, not a ball. Tiny restrained glow is confined to the rods. Brutally reduced typography and understated charcoal glass cards. A quiet futuristic auditory instrument with industrial precision.
